text:
alec: quick heads up — compliance asked for clarity on customer-managed key boundaries and audit requirements for the new private deploys. they want: who can import keys, what logs we retain, & an emergency rotation path. can we sketch this out?
mira: do they mean BYOK import into our HSM, or customers bringing wrapped keys and us only storing ciphertext?
samir: they specifically called out 'customer-held root key but service stores wrapped key'. compliance cares about attestation and split control. they want proof we never see plaintext private key.
ealec: correct. their ask: 1) RBAC roles for key import/unwrap 2) audit retention for import/activation events (90/365 days?) 3) incident rotation playbook 4) KMS vs external HSM differences for attestations
eva: for RBAC we should have at least 3 roles: key-admin (can import/wrap metadata), key-ops (can activate/deactivate), security-auditor (read-only logs). key-admin should be a small group with MFA + BYOK approval ticket.
samir: agree. add requirement: import action requires two-person approval (separation of duties). implement via ticket + signed SSM document before granting transient key-admin role.
mira: audit retention — compliance prefers 1 year for activation/import/change events and 7 years for rotation/compromise events if it's a regulated customer. default retention 365 days, escalate to 7 years per contract. we need log immutability (WORM) or exportable signed bundles.
kms-bot: automatic note: AWS KMS and Google KMS provide CloudTrail/AuditLogs. For HSM appliances we must forward syslog -> ELK and set S3 archival with object lock for immutability.
eva: attestation: for HSM-hosted BYOK we must provide an attestation report from the HSM vendor (e.g., FIPS 140-2/3 cert + HSM CSR attestation) and a hash of the imported key material proof (HKDF wrapped proof). customers will want an auditable proof we never unwrapped.
alec: vuln triage question — if a CVE hits the HSM firmware, do we proactively rotate customer keys? what's the trigger?
samir: triage policy idea: severity >= 8 AND exploit code public -> mandatory rotation. for firmware advisory without exploit, mark as elevated monitoring and issue mitigations (restrict import/activation, increase audit sampling). we need a customer notification template.
mira: emergency rotation playbook sketch: 1) create rotation ticket + generate new wrapping key in customer's KMS (if they manage root) OR generate new customer-wrapped key material flow 2) schedule low-traffic window 3) perform staged rollout with canary hosts 4) validate signatures/hash 5) mark old key as deprecated, then schedule deletion per retention policy
eva: include command snippets in playbook. e.g.:
```
# unwrap and rotate (pseudocode)
aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://wrapped_key.bin --key-id arn:aws:kms:... --output text > key_material.bin
# re-wrap with new wrapping key
aws kms encrypt --key-id new-wrap-arn --plaintext fileb://key_material.bin --output fileb://wrapped_key_v2.bin
```
(note: in BYOK we must never run unwrap on our systems unless customer explicitly authorizes and we have an escrow agreement)
alec: good call — escrow ops only with signed SLA. otherwise we force customer to perform unwrap-and-rewrap on their side or provide a signed KMS Generate/Encrypt endpoint.
samir: audit logging implementation notes: log these fields: actor, action, resource (key-id), source-ip, request-id, before/after metadata, approval-ticket-id, approval-actors. all logs must be cryptographically hashed and daily signed.
mira: add retention tags so billing/contract can toggle retention length per customer. implement as metadata on S3 archive and in our compliance DB.
eva: oncall/incident: if we suspect key compromise -> immediate steps: 1) set key to disabled 2) notify legal + compliance + customer 3) initiate rotation, 4) preserve logs + snapshot HSM state, 5) open postmortem. link to runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/key-incident (draft).
alec: ok action items: mira -> draft RBAC policy + IAM role names by EOW; samir -> rotation playbook + notification templates; eva -> update runbook with syslog/export and sample audit fields. I'll sync with legal for escrow wording.
mira: ETA note: I'll attach a sample IAM policy and a minimal Terraform snippet for enabling two-person approval (OIDC + approvers group).
samir: also need QA: simulate a blind rotation (customer performs rewrap) and confirm no plaintext passes through our infra. add to staging test matrix.
eva: thumbs up. tagging @kms-bot for any automated notes about provider limitations. :thumbsup:
alec: thanks everyone. will follow up in doc PR and ping here when drafts are ready.
